intro: Introduce your business to local residents. Once approved, publish videos of offers filmed on site and marked with a Merchant badge, within your account’s quota.

landing.title: Introduce your business to your neighbors.
landing.intro: Share a local offer in a short video filmed on site and visible in the neighborhood.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.body: Send a request with your business name and a short introduction.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.body: Our team reviews your request. Once your account is approved, your offers receive a Merchant badge.

steps.title: Publish an offer filmed on site
steps.body: Record a short video in the app, choose how long it stays visible, and share it with nearby residents.

details: Offers are for approved merchant accounts and must be filmed on site.
Choose a visibility period from the available options, between 6 hours and 7 days.
Each account has a posting quota; you can see it in your merchant space.
The platform does not yet provide reach or conversion statistics, so no business results are guaranteed.
landing.closing: A useful, clearly presented offer helps neighbors discover what is happening nearby.

pending: Your request is being reviewed by our team.
pendingDetails: You can check its status here. No response time is promised.
rejectedDetails: Review the eligibility criteria and requested information before taking any further steps.
quota: Offers published in the last 24 hours: {used} / {quota}
rules: One offer is one video filmed on site, in the Merchant category, with a visibility period from 6 hours to 7 days.
